نصطفق (form VIII)
# نَصْطَفِقُ (naṣṭafiqu) /nasˤ.tˤa.fi.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
# نَصْطَفِقَ (naṣṭafiqa) /nasˤ.tˤa.fi.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
# نَصْطَفِقْ (naṣṭafiq) /nasˤ.tˤa.fiq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
